parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the interactive message application to query.

parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The query start time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is left empty, the earliest time is used by default.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. This value must be consistent with the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Currently supported data centers are Shanghai (cn-shanghai) and Singapore (ap-southeast-1).

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The query end time, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is left empty, the latest time is used by default.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID of the group to query.

parameters.name: MsgType
parameters.description: The message type to query. If this parameter is left empty, all message types are returned by default.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The start position of the query page. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is returned by default.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of messages to display at a time. Valid values: **[10,50]**.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sort type. Messages are sorted by the time they were sent. Valid values:

- 1: ascending order

- 2: descending order
